Wyoming: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Wyoming on the map

Key dates

  • Early in-person (absentee) voting: October 6, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Takes place at county clerk sites. Hours vary by county. Many counties are open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays.
  • Recommended last day to request a mail (absentee) ballot: October 17, 2026. VOTE411 recommends asking for your ballot at least 17 days before the election. Mail ballots must arrive by 7 p.m. on Election Day. Ask your county clerk for exact deadlines.
  • Voter registration deadline (advance registration): October 19, 2026. Advance registration closes at 5 p.m. Wyoming also offers same-day registration: you can register in person during early (absentee) voting or at your polling place on Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Official election information: Wyoming Secretary of State – Election Center

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
